title: Uwell Viscore Pro+ Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod blends three classic red fruits in one vibrant flavour. Sweet Strawberry forms the base, tangy Raspberry adds a sharp edge, and juicy Cherry rounds it off with depth and richness. The result is a fruit medley that’s lively and satisfying. Each pack contains one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and one 10ml Refill Pod that automatically tops up the pod as you vape. Together, they offer up to 20,000 puffs depending on your style, with no need for coil changes or messy refills. With a built-in 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod delivers smooth vapour and consistent flavour every time. Designed exclusively for the Uwell Viscore Pro+ Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and mess-free: simply click the pod and refill into place and you’re good to go.
